title: Blob API exposure contradictory
description: OPS describes blob access as admin interface (l.2091), as public /v1/agora/blob/{cid} (l.120, 2359), and as undocumented /admin/blob/{cid} (l.2370). Fix: define one public, token/proof-gated endpoint and state whether any admin blob endpoint exists and its auth. Line numbers refer to import/ files (notes/research-2026-10-16.md).
